title: Time-Division Multiplexing
keyPoints: TDM is a digital technique combining several low-rate channels into one high-rate one (slide 25).
In synchronous TDM the link rate is n times faster and the unit duration n times shorter (slide 27).
Frame duration equals the duration of an input unit (slide 29).
Data rate management: multilevel, multislot, pulse stuffing (slide 42).
